propositions: Add nested `rebar bridge` CLI group with only `preview` and `sync` verbs, where preview forces dry-run mode and sync forces live mode.
Preview performs zero Jira writes and zero ticket or bridge-state writes; sync performs persisted mutations from production-shaped Jira fixtures while preserving unrelated state.
Reject `--mode`, `--filter-local-ids`, and arbitrary trailing arguments on both verbs to prevent override of read/write distinction.
Help text for bridge, preview, and sync must exclude internal vocabulary (mode, rank, gate, lock, cap, pass, binding store, numeric exit-code values) from public-facing output.
Unknown nested verbs fail with valid choices and never dispatch same-named top-level commands; legacy reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, and doctor remain unchanged.
Generated documentation (cli-reference, exit-codes, user-guide, release-notes) reflects only the staged bridge surface that ships.
